summary.text: Miguel Arellanes is a Democratic candidate for Missouri House of Representatives District 121 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Arellanes is a U.S. Army veteran who served from 2017 to 2022.

paragraphs.text: Miguel Arellanes served in the U.S. Army from 2017 to 2022.
In his Ballotpedia survey, Arellanes described five years on active duty as an Army engineer, rising to the rank of sergeant, with a focus on deploying the Improved Ribbon Bridge.
He said that since leaving the service he has looked for a way to continue serving his country.
Arellanes advanced from the Democratic primary on August 4, 2026.

He listed his campaign messages as fiscal responsibility to sustain social programs, a strong educational system from the start of schooling through graduation, and rural infrastructure including access to health care, child care, housing and employment.
